Given, Adam's speed is 1.5 times Barry's speed.

=> When Adam covers 3 m, Barry covers 2 m.

=> When Adam covers 3 m, Adam gains 1 m over Barry.

=> When Adam covers 3 * 200 = 600 m, Adam gains 200 m over Barry.

=> When Adam covers 600 m, Adam passes Barry 1 time.

=> When Adam covers 3000 m, Adam passes Barry = 3000/600 = 5 times.

Time taken by Nishu to complete 20 km or 20000 m = (180/900) x 20000 = 4000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 4000 sec.

Speed of Nishu = 900/180 = 5 m/sec

Speed of Mohan = 900/240 = 3.75 m/sec

Relative speed = 5 - 3.75 = 1.25 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 900/1.25 = 720 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 720 that is close to 4000, and that is 3600.

Therefore, after 3600 sec from the start Nishu meet Mohan for the last time.

Time taken by Bike A to complete 80 km or 80000 m = (300/1200) x 80000 = 20000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 20000 sec.

Speed of Bike A = 1200/300 = 4 m/sec

Speed of Bike B = 1200/360 = 10/3 m/sec

Relative speed = 4 - (10/3) = 2/3 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 1200/ (2/3) = 1800 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 1800 that is close to 20000, and that is 19800.

Therefore, after 19800 sec or 5.5 hours from the start Bike A meet Bike B for the last time.
